publications.name: The Long War – Codex Supplement Salamanders

rules.name: Strength of Nocturne
rules.description:
All Salamanders units gain the following benefits:
• All ‘Flamer’, ‘Acid’, ‘Plasma’, ‘Bio-Plasma’, ‘Melta’, ‘Fusion’, ‘Phosphor’, and ‘Volkite’ weapons have -1 to all Wound rolls against Salamanders units.
• Salamanders units with the Character special rule gain the Master-Crafted special rule on all weapons they are equipped with.

rules.name: Cautious Pace
rules.description:
• All Salamanders units have -1 to their Initiative (I) characteristic (This is included in Salamanders specific units).
• Salamanders Javelin Assault Speeders, Storm Speeders and Land Speeders gain Limited: 1 Per Detachment.
• Salamanders Tactical Terminators and Assault Terminators gain Limited: 1 Per Detachment.

sharedRules.name: Sanctified by Fire
sharedRules.description: Instead of setting to Overwatch, a unit may set to Sanctify an Objective. A unit that sets to Sanctify may select a single Objective Marker within 6” of it. That Objective Marker is removed from the battlefield and can no longer be used to score Victory Points.

sharedRules.name: Adherent of Prophecy
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule always counts as holding an objective regardless of the number of enemy models contesting the objective.

sharedRules.name: Master-Crafted Weapon
sharedRules.description: A model equipped with this wargear selects 1 weapon they are equipped with. It gains the Master-Crafted special rule. If a unit with this special rule has 2 more models and every unit has purchased this wargear, they can re-roll hit rolls of 1 instead with all Weapons they are equipped with.

sharedRules.name: Master-Crafted Promethean Armour
sharedRules.description: A model equipped with this wargear may re-roll 1 Armour Save roll per Phase. If a unit with this special rule has 2 more models and every unit has purchased this wargear, they can re-roll Armour Save rolls of 1 instead.

sharedRules.name: Dragon Rage
sharedRules.description: Wounds inflicted by a weapon with this special rule cannot be ignored with the Feel no Pain (x) special rule.

sharedRules.name: Drake Scale Shield
sharedRules.description: A model with this wargear may gains a 4+ Invulnerable Save and the Batte-Hardened special rule. In addition, the Invulnerable save is increased to 3+ against wounds caused by ‘Flamer’, ‘Acid’, ‘Plasma’, ‘Bio-Plasma’, ‘Melta’, ‘Fusion’, ‘Las’, ‘Phosphor’, and ‘Volkite’ weapons

rules.name: Forge Father
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade gains +1 to their Ballistic Skill (BS), Weapon Skill (WS), Wounds (W), Attacks (A) and Leadership (LD) characteristics. Additionally, the unit gains the Battle Smith (1) and Master of Command special rule.

rules.name: Obsidian Aquila
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear gains the Battle-Hardened special rule.

rules.name: The Salamanders Mantle
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic gains +2 to its Wounds (W) characteristic. In addition, enemy attacks against the model equipped with this Relic and its attached unit are resolved as if they had the Gets Hot! Special rule on their equipped Melee type weapons.

rules.name: The Tome of Vel’Cona
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic gains +2 Strength on all equipped Psychic Weapons.

rules.name: Vulcan’s Sigil
rules.description: Once per game, a model with this Relic may hold the Sigil high. All Salamanders units that can draw visibility to the relic bearer gain +1 to their Attack (A) characteristic until the end of the current Phase.

rules.name: Never Give Up
rules.description: Your Warlord and all friendly Salamanders units within 18” gain the Stubborn special rule and may re-roll Pinning tests.

rules.name: Anvil of Strength
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait gains +1 to its Strength (S) and Toughness (T) characteristics.

rules.name: Forge Master
rules.description:
If your army includes a model with this Warlord Trait, select 1 weapon your Warlord is equipped with that has the Master-Crafted special rule. It gains one of the following special rules this game:
• Rending (5+).
• Arcing (5+).
• Murderous Strike (5+).
• Crushing (5+).
• Shred.
• Deflagrate.

rules.name: Ashmantle
rules.description: At the end of any Combat Phase in which this model is present, all units within 3” that do not have the Salamander keyword take D6+1 Strength 3, AP6 automatic hits. Wound and save rolls are taken as normal.

rules.name: The Dragon
rules.description: This model ignores the effects of the Melta, Haywire (x), and Rending (x) special rules on weapons that target it for attacks.

infoLinks.name: And they shall know no Fear

rules.name: Kesare’s Mantle
rules.description: A model with this wargear has a 3+ Invulnerable save. A model with this wargear ignores Instant Death Wounds. When this model would take an Instant Death Wound it suffers D3 wounds instead.

rules.name: Lord of Fire
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, this unit and any attached unit gain the Shred Special rule on all equipped Flamers, Drake Flamers, Hand Flamers, Drake Hand Flamers, Heavy Flamers, and Drake Heavy Flamers. This includes the Gauntlets of the Forge.

rules.name: Fiery Form
rules.description: When this power is successfully cast, the Psyker gains an 4+ Invulnerable Save. In addition, the Psyker gains the Shred special rule on all ‘Flamer’, ‘Melta’ and ‘Plasma’ weapons they are equipped with. This effects the Molten Beam Psychic Weapon. The effects of this Psychic Power lasts until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Fire Shield
rules.description: When this power is successfully cast, All Charges declared against the Psyker and their attached unit are resolved as if the Charging unit was moving through Dangerous Terrain. This lasts until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Spontaneous Combustion
rules.description: When this power is successfully cast, select 1 enemy model with 12” the Psyker. The target enemy must make a Toughness Test. If they fail, the model is slain and removed from play. If they pass, they take D3 Automatic Wound with no saves allowed. This power cannot affect units without a Toughness (T) characteristic.
